title: The last one is not a simulation
drDigitalIntro:
Everything in this course until now has been a careful drawing of a computer. This last mission is your actual machine, and this page checks four things about it that cannot be faked.
• Your window size, measured as you drag it.
• A web address you copied from somewhere else, which only counts if it arrives by pasting.
• A PDF you saved in the last hour, checked for what it is and when you made it.
• A screenshot you took in the last hour, measured on your own computer and sent nowhere.
There is no simulator here and nothing to reset. That is the point of finishing.

playgroundTask.goal: You finished the course on your own machine

steps.say: Make this window small, then make it fill the screen.
steps.detail: Your first lesson was that a window is a thing you can pick up and change the size of. Prove it one more time.

steps.say: Read the address bar and type the address of this page.
steps.detail: The part before the first slash. The habit that catches fakes.

steps.say: Copy the web address of any other page and paste it here.
steps.detail: Open something else — a news site, a shop, an encyclopedia — click the address bar, copy the address, and paste it below.

steps.say: Save any web page as a PDF, then pick the file here.
steps.detail: Press Ctrl+P or Command+P, change the destination to Save as PDF, and save it. Then press the button and find it.

steps.say: Take a screenshot and pick it here.
steps.detail: On a Mac hold Shift and Command and press 3. On Windows hold the Windows key and Shift and press S, then save it.

steps.say: Teach one thing from this course to somebody else.
steps.detail: The last step of learning anything is saying it out loud to another person. Pick the one thing you wish somebody had told you at the start.

drDigitalSuccess: That was your computer, your files and your window — no practice machine anywhere in it. You are done.
drDigitalHint: Each step tells you exactly what it wants and why it turned something down. Nothing here is a trick.
